verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with GPU-relevant backends (Vulkan on Windows, MLX on iOS, a reserved CUDA slot), so diagnosing why GPU acceleration failed and fell back to CPU is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence describes GPU detection, fallback reporting, or diagnostic or log output explaining a CPU fallback. The backend facade and per-platform engine lists are architecture details, not diagnostics.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
